paite: Media mi, Ahasueras tapa Darias, Kaldaite tung a kumpipa ding abawl, vaihawm akum khatna,
heading: Daniel In Amite Athumsak
english: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the offspring of the Medes, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans—

paite: avaihawm akum khatna kum in kei, Daniel in laibute a kipan Jerusalem hihsiatna in kum sawmsagih daih ding ahi chih zawlnei Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung tanchin a kipan in ka theisiam hi.
english: in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years about which Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah the prophet for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, even seventy years.

paite: Huchi in Toupa PATHIAN lam ah ka mel ka koihkip a, thumna leh thilngette, an ngawlna leh sai-ip puan silh in, vut lak a tu in Toupa PATHIAN kiang ah ka ngen ngutngut hi.
english: I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and petitions, with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.

paite: Huan TOUPA ka Pathian kiang ah ka thum a, thupha ka tawi hi, "Aw TOUPA, Pathian thupi leh mulkimhuai, nang hon it a na thupiakte zuite tung a thukhun leh zahngaihna vom;
english: I prayed to Yahweh my God, and made confession, and said, “Oh, Lord, the great and dreadful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments,

paite: ka na khialta ua, hoih loutak in ka gamtang ua, giloutak in ka na hihta ua, ka hel ua, na thuseh leh na vaihawmte ka na lehngatsanta uhi.
english: we have sinned, and have dealt perversely, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even turning aside from your precepts and from your ordinances.

paite: Ka kumpipate uh, ka vaihawmtute uleh ka pipute uh leh gam a mi tengteng kiang a na min a thugen, na sikha zawlneite thu leng ka na ngaikhe kei uhi.
english: We haven’t listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

paite: Aw TOUPA, diktatna nang a ahi a, himahleh tuni bang in, kou a bel zahlakna leh buaina ahi; Judah a mite, Jerusalem a tengte, Israel tengteng, anai leh gamla a omte, na tung a atatlekna ziak un amaute gam tengteng ah delhzak in ka om uhi.
english: “Lord, righteousness belongs to you, but to us confusion of face, as it is today; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to all Israel, who are near and who are far off, through all the countries where you have driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against you.

paite: "Aw TOUPA, ka kumpipate, ka vaihawmte uh, ka pipute uh leh kou hon suangtute'n na tung a dikloutak a akhelh ziak un zahlakna in hon khuh hi.
english: Lord, to us belongs confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.

paite: Amah tung ah na helta mah le ung zahngaihnate leh ngaihdamnate TOUPA ka Pathian uh a ahi.
english: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against him.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw leh adante a om ding a asikha zawlneite zang a ka ma ua hon na koihsakte ka na mangta kei uhi.
english: We haven’t obeyed Yahweh our God’s voice, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

paite: Ahi, Israel tengteng in na dan atatleksan ua, ahilou lam ah apial ua, na aw amanlouhna ding un; huaiziak in na tung a ka hihkhelhte ziak in Mosi, Pathian sikha dan sung a gelh a om kichiamna hamsia ka tung ah sunbuak in a-omta hi.
english: Yes, all Israel have transgressed your law, turning aside, and not obeying your voice. “Therefore the curse and the oath written in the law of Moses the servant of God has been poured out on us, for we have sinned against him.

paite: "Huan koute demna leh ka tung ua vaihawmte demna thute leh ka tung ua siatna thupitak in ahihkip khinta hi; Jerusalem tung a kihih bang van nuai pumpi ah lah akihih ngei ngal kei a.
english: He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great evil; for under the whole sky, such has not been done as has been done to Jerusalem.

paite: Mosi Dan sung a gelh ahih bang in, hiai siatna tengteng ka tung uah ahong tung hi; huchipi in leng ka thulimlouhnate uh kiheisan a, na thutak a theihkhen theihna ka neihtheihna ding un TOUPA ka Pathian uh deihsakna ka ngen nai kei lai uhi.
english: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil has come on us. Yet we have not entreated the favor of Yahweh our God, that we should turn from our iniquities and have discernment in your truth.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA ka Pathian uh athilhihte tengteng a adiktat gige man in, TOUPA'N thil hoih lou en gige in, ka tung uah ahon tungsakta hi; hinapi in kou lah a-aw ka na mangta kei uhi.
english: Therefore Yahweh has watched over the evil, and brought it on us; for Yahweh our God is righteous in all his works which he does, and we have not obeyed his voice.

paite: Huan tu in, Aw TOUPA ka Pathian uh, khut hattak a na mite Aigupta gam a kipan pikhepa leh tuni bang a minthanna kimuhpa, tuni bang in ka khialta ua, giloutak in ka na hihta uhi.
english: “Now, Lord our God, who has brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have gotten yourself renown, as it is today, we have sinned. We have done wickedly.

paite: "Aw TOUPA, ka hon ngen ahi, na diktatna tengteng ziak in, na hehna leh thangpaihna, na khopi Jerusalem leh na tang siangthou a kipan kihei mangsak in; ka khelhnate uh ziak leh ka pipute uh thulimlouhna ziak in, Jerusalem leh na mite lah ka kim ka vel ua omte tengteng simmoh ahong hita uhi.
english: Lord, according to all your righteousness, please let your anger and your wrath be turned away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain; because for our sins and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people have become a reproach to all who are around us.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, Aw ka Pathian uh, na sikha thumna leh athilngette ngaikhia inla, TOUPA ziak in, asegawpsa na mun siangthou tung ah na mel vaksak in.
english: “Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on your sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.

paite: Aw ka Pathian, na bil hon doh inla, za in; na mitte hak inla, na min a kilou na khopi siatgawpnate en in; ka diktatna ziak un na ma a hiai ka thilngetnate uh lan ka hi ngal kei ua, na zahngaihna thupite ziak in ahi zaw hi.
english: My God, turn your ear and hear. Open your eyes and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name; for we do not present our petitions before you for our righteousness, but for your great mercies’ sake.

paite: Aw TOUPA, za in, Aw TOUPA ngaidam in, Aw TOUPA, ngaikhia inla hih in; hal ke'n; nangmah ziak mahmah in, Aw ka Pathian, na khopi leh na mite nang min pute ahi uhi," achi hi.
english: Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. Don’t defer, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.”

paite: Huchi a thu ka gen a, ka thum a, ka khelhna leh ka mi Israel khelhna thupha ka tawi a, TOUPA ka Pathian ma a ka Pathian tang siangthou a dingh a thilngetna ka piak lai in;
heading: Gabriel In Genkholhna Ahilhchian
english: While I was speaking, praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before Yahweh my God for the holy mountain of my God—

paite: ahi, thumna a thu ka gen lai in, pasal Gabriel, achil a mengmuhna a ka muh pa, kintak a leng dia bawl a om in, nitaklam thillat hun ding in ahong khoih hi.
english: yes, while I was speaking in prayer—the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening offering.

paite: Huan ahon thuhilh a, ahon houpih a, "Aw Daniel, theihsiamna a siam mahmah a hon bawl ding in tu in ka hong paikhia hi," achi hi.
english: He instructed me and talked with me, and said, “Daniel, I have now come to give you wisdom and understanding.

paite: Na thilngetna kipat phet in adawnna piak ahi; nang hilh ding a hong pai ka hi, nakpitak a it lah na hi ngal a; huaiziak in thu ngaihtuah inla, mengmuhte theisiam in.
english: At the beginning of your petitions the commandment went out, and I have come to tell you, for you are greatly beloved. Therefore consider the matter and understand the vision.

paite: "Na mite leh na khopi siangthou a ding in tatlekna hihbeina ding, khelhnate tawpsakna ding leh thulimlouhna a dia kilemna bawlna ding, tangtawn diktatna laklutna ding leh mengmuhte leh genkholhnate khakkhum bikbekna ding leh asiangthoupen thaunilhna ding in na tung ah nipikal sawmsagih hun seh leh thu piak ahi.
english: “Seventy weeks are decreed on your people and on your holy city, to finish disobedience, to make an end of sins, to make reconciliation for iniquity, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most holy.

paite: Huaiziak in thei inla, theisiam in, Jerusalem tungding nawn ding leh lam ding a thupiak apaikhiak a kipan sathau nilh a ompa, vaihawm tan in, nipikal sagih ahi ding; huan nipikal sawmguk-le-nih sung in hun haksa mahmahte akongzing leh bukna phaizang toh akilam nawn ding hi.
english: “Know therefore and discern that from the going out of the commandment to restore and build Jerusalem to the Anointed One, the prince, will be seven weeks and sixty-two weeks. It will be built again, with street and moat, even in troubled times.

paite: "Nipikal sawmguk-le-nih khit chiang in sathau nilh a ompa satkhiak in a-om ding a, bangmah anei kei ding hi; huchi in ahong om ding vaihawmpa leh mite'n khopi leh mun siangthou ahihse ding ua; hun tawpna tui khang bang in ahong tung ding, huan atawp dong kidouna leh siatgawpnate om ding a guankholhsa ahita hi.
english: After the sixty-two weeks the Anointed One will be cut off, and will have nothing. The people of the prince who come will destroy the city and the sanctuary. Its end will be with a flood, and war will be even to the end. Desolations are determined.

paite: Huchi in nipikal khat a ding in tampi toh thukhun khauhtak abawl ding a; nipikal kimkhat a ding in kithoihna leh thillat atawpsak ding hi; mun siangthou ah mulkimhuai leh kihhuai atungkhe ding a; amah tung a tung dia guankholhsa hun tawp leh thangpaihna atung ah sunbuak ahih tan a-om ding hi,” achi hi.
english: He will make a firm covenant with many for one week. In the middle of the week he will cause the sacrifice and the offering to cease. On the wing of abominations will come one who makes desolate; and even to the decreed full end, wrath will be poured out on the desolate.”
